title: Foundation as Seed, Center, Platform and Time-Origin
status: project synthesis over cross-domain foundation records
purpose: State what becomes visible once foundations of nations, religions, schools, philosophies, standards, companies and projects are modeled with the same time-aware grammar.

revelations.title: Most important systems have more than one birth.
revelations.synthesis: Authorization, declaration, legal effect, first operation and consolidation are different Doors. Treating only one as 'founded' hides how institutions actually come alive.
examples: University of Copenhagen: 1475 authorization → 1479 inauguration → 1537/1539 refoundation.
CERN: 1953 signed convention → 1954 entry into force.

revelations.title: A Foundation is strongest when it reproduces itself.
revelations.synthesis: A founding text alone is inert unless teaching, succession, governance, ritual, standards, assets or membership rules let later people recreate the system.

revelations.title: Refoundation is a first-class event.
revelations.synthesis: Systems can preserve identity while changing the platform beneath them. Refoundation should therefore be modeled explicitly rather than hidden as an ordinary timeline note.

revelations.title: Foundations create planes of possibility.
revelations.synthesis: After F0, actions become thinkable/legal/meaningful that were not available in the same form before: offices can be filled, degrees granted, standards implemented, rituals repeated, members admitted, products built or disputes interpreted.
revelations.project_relation: This is the Foundation-as-Plane clue: Plane is not the same as foundation, but foundation can establish the operating plane.

revelations.title: The Center is often a document, rite, event and institution at once.
revelations.synthesis: People return to foundations during dispute because they compress identity into an inspectable reference: constitution, charter, scripture, creed, rule, manifesto, founder practice or original protocol.
revelations.project_relation: Foundation-as-Center is therefore an archive/interpretation function, not only spatial symbolism.

revelations.title: Ancient traditions often have foundation intervals rather than foundation dates.
revelations.synthesis: Judaism, Daoism, Confucian traditions, Buddhism and the Platonic Academy demonstrate why modern corporate birthday logic should not be projected backward.
revelations.rule: Use ranges, traditional origins and later institutional consolidation as separate clocks.

revelations.title: Corporate genealogy can be as layered as religious genealogy.
revelations.synthesis: ASML inherits Philips R&D before its 1984 operational birth; Novo Nordisk preserves two predecessor lineages before a 1989 merger; Maersk's 1912 autonomy move matters after the 1904 official foundation.
revelations.implication: Enterprise history should store predecessor Roots, operational F0, mergers/refoundations and branch/spin-off events.

revelations.title: A foundation is an anti-amnesia device.
revelations.synthesis: When current practice drifts, preserved F0/F1/F2 states allow comparison rather than nostalgic guessing.
revelations.implication: Every foundation record should retain superseded statutes, old creeds, old standards and earlier institutional purposes when available.

implementation.global_foundation_graph: Any durable Subject may point to one or more Foundation records. Foundation records can themselves be Subjects with dates, artifacts, authors/parties and descendants.
implementation.timeline: Render all foundation clocks in one chronology with domain filters and distinct icons for seed, authorization, entry into force, operation, consolidation and refoundation.
implementation.entity_pages: Show 'Founded / constituted / current foundation' as multiple clocks rather than one date.
implementation.religions: Reuse and enrich existing religious-foundations layer rather than replace it.
implementation.countries: Constitutional foundations should appear beside older nation/state formation so state identity is not flattened to constitutional birthday.
implementation.companies: Store predecessor Roots, incorporation/operation and merger/refoundation separately.
implementation.philosophies_schools: Allow approximate date ranges and place/teacher/method instead of demanding legal instruments.
implementation.project: Potatoism should show project-canon foundation states with explicit evidence class and conversation/source genealogy.

next_population: families/dynasties/kingdom lines where evidence supports durable succession rules
